title: A Bayesian Threshold-Crossing Joint Model for Irregular, Assay-Floor-Censored Molecular Monitoring in Chronic Myeloid Leukemia: code and synthetic data

description:
Reproducibility materials for a Bayesian joint model in which deep molecular response (DMR) in chronic myeloid leukemia is read off a latent log-MRD trajectory as a threshold crossing (first-hitting time), rather than coded as a separate event. Because DMR is defined as log-MRD ≤ -4.5, predicting a coded event from the same biomarker is circular; the crossing formulation removes this. The longitudinal sub-model treats assay-floor values as left-censored and the endpoint is interval-observed. A conventional interval-censored hazard and a multi-state extension (onset, durability, relapse) are options of the same Stan program.

No patient data are included. The clinical cohort contains identifiable health information and cannot be shared. A fully synthetic dataset of identical structure, generated from the fitted model's posterior predictive distribution, is provided so the pipeline runs end-to-end. Aggregate results (posterior summaries, simulation operating characteristics, calibration bins) are included; patient-level derived files are not.
